conditions.name: Mandibular Nonunion (Nonunion of Mandible)

ratingSchedule.note: DC 9903, mandible, nonunion of, confirmed by diagnostic imaging studies.

reviewNotes: Keep this specific nonunion residual distinct from the existing broader maxillofacial-fracture identity. A history of mandibular fracture does not by itself establish nonunion.
DC 9903 is rating context only and does not establish service connection, chronicity, or medical nexus.
